What is crush-bin?

Crush is a terminal-based AI coding agent from Charm (makers of Bubble Tea and Glow) that works alongside you directly in the command line. It can switch between many LLM providers mid-session without losing context, understands your project through LSP integration, and extends itself through MCP servers over HTTP, stdio, or SSE. Session history and project context are stored locally in SQLite, so nothing is lost between restarts.

Install crush-bin on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add crush-bin

Good to know

  • An API key from at least one supported LLM provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Vertex AI, or a local model via Ollama/llama.cpp)
  • Network access to reach the chosen model provider
